text: R02 found an additional geometry defect relevant to D02: exact-replayed C04 forward states can have positive voxel-difference Jacobians while their actual trilinear cells fold. Existing unchanged complete-cell evaluator finds9/12 C4 forward fields with folds, including r24 fixed12 cells/minJ-.222107 and moving33/minJ-1.556543; all complete cells retained. Independent smooth-cell analytic/finite-difference probes confirm local reversals, including inside the original grid. Complete-cell qualification of endpoint maps alone does not establish cell validity of authoritative midpoint forward states used for inversion. More accurate roots/padding fail the whole-boundary contract. This is synthetic observed-data evidence, not an MRI failure claim or source change. See halfflow-boundary-representation-v1.md and evidence/halfflow-boundary-20261014/c04-outcomes-v1. Keep D02/R02 and candidate gates open; incorporate forward-state cell admission and extension/branch behavior in the remaining diagnosis.
